questions.q: What were the major challenges of nation building faced by India after Independence?
answer: When India became independent in 1947, it faced three great challenges of nation building.

answer.text: The first was to shape a single nation out of a land of immense diversity of religions, languages, castes and regions, and to accommodate this diversity without letting it break the country apart. The trauma of Partition made this even harder.
The second was to establish and nurture democracy, by adopting a Constitution based on rights, universal suffrage and free elections, in a society that was largely poor and illiterate.
The third was to ensure the development and well-being of all, removing poverty and inequality so that the benefits of progress reached every section of society.
Alongside these, the immediate task of integrating over five hundred princely states, achieved chiefly by Sardar Patel, was accomplished.

answer: Meeting these challenges laid the foundations of the modern Indian nation.
